note: Time-to-first-finding on a cold cache. This engine is batch, so this equals time-to-all-findings today. The top-level ms is the original CI measurement for a 209-file target and is used for local runs only; the scanned tree has since grown to about 367 files, so on the hosted runner the budget comes from the `hosted` block, measured on the current target.

hosted.derivedFrom: time-to-first-finding lines in the release workflow runs of 2026-10-25 and 2026-10-26 that passed their gate (ten runs); ms is the median, the factor is a little above the largest sample over the median (12775/11133 = 1.15). The two runs that exposed the 0.186.0 slowdown (15373, 17861 and 18521 ms) are not in the sample and exceed the limit (15030 ms).
